CREATE TABLE D360.NEGATIVE_LIST
(
	 [Category]	VARCHAR(255)	NOT NULL
	,[Entity Type]	VARCHAR(50)	NOT NULL
	,[Item No./Case Number]	VARCHAR(100)	NOT NULL
	,[First Name]	VARCHAR(50)	NULL
	,[Middle Name]	VARCHAR(50)	NULL
	,[Last Name / Corporate Name]	VARCHAR(255)	NOT NULL
	,[Date of Birth / Date of Incorporation]	[date]		NULL
	,[TIN]	VARCHAR(20)	NULL
	,[Residence / Business Address]	VARCHAR(255)	NULL
	,[Business / Employer Name / Registered Owner] 	VARCHAR(255)	NULL
	,[Sureties / Signatories / Co-Borrower]	VARCHAR(255)	NULL
	,[Position / Relationship to Entity]	VARCHAR(255)	NULL
	,[Alleged Violation / Adverse Report / Case]	VARCHAR(255)	NOT NULL
	,[Plaintiff / Mortgagee]	VARCHAR(150)	NULL
	,[Item in Question]	VARCHAR(255)	NULL
	,[Remarks/ Court Order / Resolution / Special Instructions]	VARCHAR(Max)	NULL
	,[Case Update / Narrative Update]	VARCHAR(Max)	NULL
	,[Amount Involved]	Decimal	(15,2)	NOT NULL
	,[Reference / Source / Website]	VARCHAR(255)	NOT NULL
	,[Issue Date]	[date]		NULL
	,[Publication Date/ Release Date / Received Date]	[date]		NOT NULL
	,[Encoded Date]	[date]		NOT NULL
	,[Encoded By]	VARCHAR(255)	NOT NULL
	,[Updated Date]	[date]		NULL
	,[Updated By]	VARCHAR(255)	NULL

)
WITH
(
DISTRIBUTION=ROUND_ROBIN,HEAP

)
